description: Phase-1 data collection for PREREG RC1 (docs/PREREG_regime_composite.md): six free, key-less public sources (Binance USD-M funding/premium/metrics, GDELT news tone for 'bitcoin', and Bitstamp BTC/USD daily price) merged into one daily regime-feature table.
source: raw/binance_funding.csv: Binance USD-M monthly archive fundingRate (data.binance.vision, 2020-01..2026-08). raw/binance_premium.csv: Binance USD-M premiumIndexKlines, 1d (same archive; current month falls back to per-day files). raw/binance_metrics.csv: Binance USD-M daily metrics, 5-minute rows averaged to one row per day (2021-01-01..2026-08-31). raw/gdelt_tone.csv: GDELT doc API timelinetone for query 'bitcoin' (api.gdeltproject.org, refilled in quarter-sized chunks due to rate limits on year-sized queries). raw/price_daily.csv: Bitstamp BTC/USD daily, read from data/attention/attention.csv. features_daily.csv: derived from the five raw files by scripts/fetch_regime_composite.py's build_features(). See that script's module docstring and manifest.json (non-tabular, in the same directory) for exact coverage/missing-day provenance.
retention: permanent dated snapshot (backtest_data/regime_composite_20260901/); the fetch script is resumable (reuses whatever already sits in raw/*.csv and requests only the still-missing periods) but this specific directory, once frozen, is never regenerated in place.

funding_3d_mean.meaning: trailing 3-calendar-day mean of binance_funding.csv's funding_rate (>=1 observation required)
funding_3d_mean.notes: blank if no funding observation fell in the trailing window

premium_1d.notes: blank on days with no premium row

ls_ratio.notes: blank when the metrics row's count_long_short_ratio is itself empty

toptrader_ls.meaning: same-day binance_metrics.csv sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio (top-trader POSITION long/short ratio)
toptrader_ls.notes: blank when the metrics row's sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio is itself empty

tone_7d_mean.meaning: trailing 7-calendar-day mean of gdelt_tone.csv's tone, requiring >=4 observations in the window
tone_7d_mean.notes: blank if fewer than 4 tone observations fell in the trailing 7-day window

ret_28d.meaning: 28-day log return of price_daily.csv's close, ln(close[t] / close[t-28])
ret_28d.notes: blank unless both endpoints (t and t-28) exist on the price calendar

close.notes: blank on days with no price row

funding_rate.meaning: mean of that day's fundingRate observations (Binance charges funding every 8h, so typically <=3 observations/day)

n.meaning: number of funding observations averaged into this day's rate

premium_close.meaning: daily premiumIndexKlines close (perp mark price premium over the index)

n_5min.meaning: number of 5-minute source rows averaged into this day (data completeness indicator)
n_5min.notes: a day well below the ~288 expected 5-minute rows had partial source coverage for that day

count_toptrader_long_short_ratio.meaning: daily mean of countTopTraderLongShortRatio (top-trader ACCOUNT count long/short ratio)

sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio.meaning: daily mean of sumTopTraderLongShortRatio (top-trader POSITION long/short ratio)
sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio.notes: distinct from count_toptrader_long_short_ratio -- account count vs position size, same caveat as schema/binance_daily.json

count_long_short_ratio.meaning: daily mean of countLongShortRatio (all-account long/short ratio)

sum_taker_long_short_vol_ratio.meaning: daily mean of sumTakerLongShortVolRatio (taker buy/sell volume ratio)

tone.meaning: GDELT timelinetone value for query 'bitcoin' on this day
tone.unit: GDELT tone score (roughly -100..+100, negative=more negative sentiment)

known_defects: GDELT rate-limits (429) and resets connections on year-sized timelinetone queries -- gdelt_tone.csv is backfilled in quarter-sized chunks, so a thin patch of missing days around a past rate-limit event is expected, not necessarily a live collection failure

Binance publishes the CURRENT month's premiumIndexKlines only as per-day files (the monthly archive 404s until the month closes) -- binance_premium.csv's most recent ~month is stitched from per-day fetches and may have a different micro-structure (still one row/day) than the archived months

Binance archive timestamps are epoch milliseconds in most files but microseconds in a few -- scripts/fetch_regime_composite.py decides the unit per value by digit count; this raw csv already stores a plain YYYY-MM-DD date, but re-deriving anything from a raw upstream Binance file directly should re-check this

features_daily.csv columns are frequently blank (not zero) where the underlying raw series had no observation for that day/window -- averaging or differencing across a blank cell will propagate NaN, which is correct; do not fill with 0
